name: tts
description: Cross-platform text-to-speech using built-in OS engines: 'say' on macOS, 'espeak-ng' on Linux, PowerShell System.Speech on Windows. Lightweight (no ML model). Listens on tts.speak, exposes voices via tts.voices.list.

default_subscriptions.description: Speak a piece of text aloud. Payload: TextPayload with `content`. Optional metadata: `voice` (string, picked from tts.voices.list), `rate` (number, words/min — backend-specific).
Request the list of available voices on this host. Reply is published on tts.voices.
